client: Riverside Tech Park (Dong Nai), HR office
subject: Drinks for a staff event
body: We need 120 cups for a staff event on 28 Oct, about 70% of them with no sugar. Budget is VND 8,400,000. Please deliver to Building 3 by 14:30 and send a menu with prices.

subject: Daily order for sports week
body: We want about 40 cups a day for 5 days, 20 Oct to 24 Oct, total budget MYR 1,800. Please confirm before 15 Oct so we can tell parents.

client: 青岛海岸商业管理（加盟意向方）
subject: 加盟咨询
body: 我们想在青岛开 15 家店，首期先开 3 家，首店位置在台东步行街，面积约 45 平方米，月租金约 45,000 元。总预算 220 万元。请提供加盟方案、首期投入明细和开业时间表。

subject: Drinks for our office opening
body: We are opening a new office next week and would like to order drinks for the ceremony. Our admin team will confirm the headcount by Friday. Can you do a mix of milk tea and fruit tea, and do you deliver to Nongsa?

subject: Fresh milk supply offer
body: We can supply fresh milk at 5,000 L per week, 3.6% fat, at MYR 4.20 per litre. For an annual contract we offer 18% off. Protein stays above 3.2 g per 100 mL. Delivery 3 times a week.

subject: Weekly corporate order
body: Every Monday at 9 am we would like 8 trays of 12 cups delivered to our Hanoi office, invoiced monthly. Please include an allergen list for each drink and confirm the price per tray.

subject: Order 50 cups for our new line
body: Our new production line opens next month. For the first day we actually need only 5 cups for the management team. The 50 cups is for the full-team celebration later; the date is not fixed yet. Price for both please.

subject: Kiosk in our food court
body: We have a 6 m2 kiosk space available. Rent is 50,000 baht per month plus a 10% revenue share. The food court sees about 600 drink sales a day across all stalls. Interested in a Teaheart kiosk?

subject: 校园店合作
body: 我们的商业街在大学城，预计一家饮品店每天可以卖 2000杯。校方要求饮品含糖量在 35 克以下。希望 2027 年 3 月前开业。请问加盟条件和首期投入是多少？

subject: Master franchise for the Philippines
body: We want to open 30 stores over 3 years. The first flagship store is 320 m2 in Cebu IT Park, with a first-store budget of PHP 1.2 million. Please send the master franchise terms.

subject: Two staff cafes, budget USD 150k
body: We want two small Teaheart counters inside our plant for about 800 staff. Our budget is around USD 150,000 and the target opening is 1 Feb 2027. Each counter should serve at least 25 cups per hour at peak.

subject: Sampling campaign
body: Our canteen sells about 2,000 cups a day across 4 stalls. We would like Teaheart to run a sampling campaign where about 5% of daily cups are free samples for one month. What would this cost?
